prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：AI_Mini_Paper 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT04 (具身智能视觉-力触觉闭环操作与 Sim-to-Real 自适应完整小论文（TacFlow: Contact-Aware Visuomotor Policy）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP08 -> BP01 -> BP03`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: In this paper, we propose a novel and groundbreaking model called DyTS-Net. It has three modules: Module A, Module B, and Module C. They work together to delve into the data and get state-of-the-art performance.
structural_constraints: S1 [方法登场与定位 Method Introduction]：To address this dilemma, we propose [Model Name], a [Core Paradigm] framework that [Primary Goal].
S2 [核心直觉洞察 Key Insight]：Our key insight is that [Physical/Statistical Principle]，点破破局的底层支点。
S3 [模块协同主干 Module Synergy]：用 First / Specifically 与 Concurrently / Furthermore 简述两大核心模块如何分工咬合。
S4 [闭环收益总结 Closed-Loop Benefit]：说明这种协同设计如何同时兼顾原先冲突的两个指标（如兼顾平稳表征与幅值保真，或兼顾多模态多样性与单步实时控制）。
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: IELTS Task 1 流程图（Process Diagram）/ 论文系统工程 Pipeline 描述段
domain_context: 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）与消融防御
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写雅思 Task 1 工艺/自然循环流程图（或论文算法数据预处理与闭环训练流水线）：把 5–6 个串联、分叉与回环步骤写得层次分明，绝不机械连用 Then, Then, Then。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 2：整篇小作文 / 演讲 / Rebuttal 闭环构建】结合今日所学蓝图 `BP29` 与全文样板 `FT04` 的后半部分（`BP05 -> BP07 -> BP11`），完成一篇包含“破题/总起 → 核心机制/正方论证 → 让步反驳/消融归因 → 边界收束”的完整短文，并用 `L030` 七维自检表逐项核验。
source_material_or_draft: Here is Figure 3. You can see many lines here. Our model is the blue line and it is the lowest, which means our model is the best on all horizons.
structural_constraints: S1 [流程总括与起止界定 Lifecycle Overview]：The diagram illustrates the closed-loop pipeline for [Process Name], comprising [N] main stages from initial [Input Stage] to continuous [Feedback/Output Stage].
S2 [前段采集与预处理 Initial Ingestion & Filtering]：The process begins when raw [Material/Data] is collected via [Source] and passed through [Filter/Chamber] to remove [Impurities/Outliers].
S3 [中段并行分流 Parallel Branching]：Once purified, the stream bifurcates into two parallel pathways: [Fraction A] undergoes [Process A], whereas [Fraction B] is routed to [Process B].

S4 [末端合成与闭环回流 Synthesis & Closed-Loop Recycling]：The resulting outputs are subsequently merged in [Unit C], with residual by-products / high-error trajectories recycled back into the initial buffer for iterative refinement.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例
